headline: Cameroon Moves to Buy Globeleq Power Stakes for $140 Million
summary: Cameroon has authorised its state electricity company to pursue the acquisition of British power producer Globeleq’s majority interests in two plants that supply more than a fifth of the country’s principal electricity network.
why: State buyouts of critical infrastructure assets shift operational and financial control to governments, directly altering the regulatory and ownership landscape in developing energy markets.

impacts.name: Globeleq
impacts.why: Globeleq is the power producer whose majority stakes are being targeted for acquisition by Cameroon.
